answer: Fingerprint the challenge itself: every epoch the coordinator embeds a private per-request seed, so each agent's prompt carries a unique beacon nonce and its reply is scored against a seeded hash. A farm cloning one polished quill of text across N accounts produces N identical response fingerprints, and replaying answers across cohorts draws a detectable correlation spiral; the coordinator entropy means forking to N identities multiplies fresh-work cost by N, so sybil replies cannot be recycled and each head must genuinely reason every epoch.
